propositions: run_git_write's transient retry covers only read-side faults (bad object, parse head) but not write-side temp-file faults (unable to create temporary file, failed to insert into database, unable to index file)
event_append._git_add retries write-side faults via its private _with_transient_add_retry, but s3_doctor and other run_git_write callers lack protection against the same fault class
The identical runner-fs fault is retried on event_append's git add path but causes hard CI failure when routed through the shared seam (bug unheedful-custodial-bluebottle)
Write-side transient markers must be moved from event_append into the shared gitutil seam as a single definition so all run_git_write callers inherit bounded retry
Corrupt-object signatures (loose object is corrupt, inflate data stream error) must remain excluded from retry
Nested transient retry composition in event_append (head retry around add retry) gives write operations an accidental 3x3 budget instead of the intended bounded 3 attempts
